name: AgenticCommerceAccountLinking
description: Turns on UCP account linking and the OpenID server, and adds the OAuth scopes UCP agents ask buyers for: checking out as them and reading their orders. Add an OpenID application for each agent platform, with authorization code and PKCE, and put its client ID on the platform.
author: CrestApps

steps.name: OpenIdScope
steps.Description: Lets an AI agent check out as you, with your saved addresses.

steps.name: OpenIdScope
steps.Description: Lets an AI agent see your orders.

steps.name: OpenIdScope
steps.Description: Lets an AI agent change your orders.
